name: Convert tractmeasures datatype to tractprofile datatype
summary: Converts a tractmeasures CSV (all tracts in one table) into the deprecated tractprofile format with one profile CSV per tract, using pandas.
description: Utility that splits the tractmeasures table by structureID and writes one <tract>_profiles.csv per tract without the subject, structure and node ID columns. Use it only to feed Apps that still require the deprecated tractprofile datatype.

inputs.description: Tract profiles table (tractmeasures.csv) with subjectID, structureID and nodeID columns.

outputs.description: Directory with one <tract>_profiles.csv per tract (tractprofile format).
